entries.title: RESOURCE_DISTRIBUTION_TOO_UBIQUITOUS
entries.correction: Minerals now use sparse purposeful distribution by state archetype, richness, magic and Root Deep.

entries.title: ROOT_DEEP_LATE_CONVERSION_MISSING_ROOT_SHARD
entries.correction: Late Root Deep conversion now injects required MIN-ROOT-SHARD and revalidates incompatible content.

entries.title: MOVED_NPC_INVENTORY_COUNTED_AT_ORIGIN
entries.correction: Hierarchy aggregation uses NPC current block/city rather than birth container.

entries.title: SCENE_DUNGEON_INVENTORY_SCOPE_MISSING
entries.correction: Dungeon and scene object inventories added to hierarchy.

entries.title: PORTABLE_TORCH_TIED_TO_SOURCE_SCENE
entries.correction: Carried torch can be lit/extinguished from inventory after travel.

entries.title: COUNTRY_PURCHASE_DID_NOT_CHARGE_CURRENCY
entries.correction: Runtime wallet + shop cash + dynamic quote + conservation implemented.

entries.title: GROUND_DUNGEON_WEAPONS_NOT_EQUIPPABLE
entries.correction: Carried dungeon weapons now have item instances, stats, equip/unequip.

entries.title: BRIDGE_REPAIR_OVERCONSUMED_AND_NOT_IDEMPOTENT
entries.correction: Repair consumes only units needed; full bridge consumes zero.

entries.title: DERIVED_FLORA_FAUNA_RESOURCE_NAMES_GENERIC
entries.correction: Species-specific derived item references and author-approved names added.

entries.title: AUDITOR_GLOBAL_RESOURCE_TYPE_DUPLICATE_FALSE_POSITIVE
entries.correction: Auditor distinguishes reusable resource type IDs from entity instance IDs.

entries.title: STAGE13_V1_0_STALE_BASELINE_AND_STALE_PASS_EVIDENCE
entries.correction: Authoritative V1.2.1 audit anchored to V1.1 sealed upstream; stale evidence isolated in history.

entries.title: MONOLITHIC_TEST_RUNNER_EXCEEDS_EXECUTOR_WINDOW
entries.correction: Regression gate executes modules in fresh isolated processes and consolidates results.

entries.title: READINESS_AUDITOR_SELF_CREATED_PYCACHE_THEN_FAILED_HYGIENE
entries.correction: Syntax gate now uses Python compile() in memory; auditor no longer writes bytecode into audited tree.

note: Zero known failures means zero failures in the defined validated scope; it is not a mathematical proof that no undiscovered defect can exist.
